questions.prompt: A read returns text with an API key, and a post-execute listener replaces the key with [redacted key]. What does the session record hold?
options: The original text, because the record keeps everything the body returned
Nothing, because redacted results are not recorded
The redacted text, because the record holds what the model sees
questions.explanation: Post-execute runs before the tool/result event is written. The recorded result is the model-facing one, after the replacement.

questions.prompt: A lint plugin returns block with the feedback "line 3: missing )" after a write. What does the model receive?
options: An error result whose text is "line 3: missing )"
The original successful result and a separate warning
A request to approve the write
questions.explanation: Block turns the result into an error, and its content is the feedback, so the model reads exactly what to fix.

questions.prompt: Why are added contexts placed after all of the step's tool results instead of right after each one?
options: Because contexts are larger than results
So every tool call stays directly next to its own result in the record
Because the model ignores messages between results
So contexts can be deleted later
questions.explanation: A call and its result must stay together. Putting the extra messages after the whole step keeps that pairing intact.
